collarConstruction.innerBoundary: Existing cubic I_i(R,Q) retained with inherited shared Q.
collarConstruction.outwardNormal: Resolved at Q using signed E-Q relation, then propagated continuously along each inner curve; no arbitrary normal flip.
collarConstruction.widthField: Low-dimensional Hermite field constrained by authored R/E/S station ordering and signed E/S normal widths; root widths 8px each, one common `parts.opening.collar_front_width` 14px, positive floor 1.5px; field tangents at E/S are derived and endpoint derivatives solve paired sweep continuity.
collarConstruction.outerBoundary: O_i = I_i + w_i n_i + H(t)(Qprime-Q-w_front*n_i(1)), H=3t^2-2t^3; both outer endpoints are the same derived Qprime, with opposite oriented contour derivatives matching at the join.
collarConstruction.trim: Typed `trim` edge is exactly the generated outer sampled point list, which is part of the closed wrap-strip contour; no independent overlay curve or triangle-mask line.
collarConstruction.supportSeam: Pair support planes are aligned along the full Q-to-Qprime world seam by adjusting each plane's tangent depth-gradient component to their shared average and preserving both transverse gradient components. Origin depths coincide at Q.
collarConstruction.actualCoordinateInputs: R/E/S (3) per collar; Q inherited from opening; Qprime and all handles derived. Whole-scene maximum remains 4 authored coordinate inputs.
collarConstruction.guards: Reject zero/nonfinite widths, undefined/degenerate shared normal bisector or endpoint normal basis, discontinuous outward normals, and any nonadjacent intersection among generated sampled outline edges.

worldSeam.transverseDepthGradient: Preserved for each collar plane; regression compares before/after gradient projections normal to the seam.
